storyCards.headline: You Gotta Be: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Des'ree's "You Gotta Be" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "You Gotta Be" is an R&B/soul song by British singer and songwriter Des'ree, written by her with Ashley Ingram, who produced the song.

It is the third track on the singer's second album, I Ain't Movin' (1994), and the opening track on the US release of that album.

The song was released as a single in March 1994 by Sony Soho Square, becoming a top-40 hit in several countries, and a top-10 hit in the United States and Australia.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 44 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #5 on the Hot 100.
